acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given the CI pipeline runs on every PR/push, When Pa11y and axe-core analyze the page, Then Pa11y runs against localhost build URL, axe-core validates accessibility rules, build fails if accessibility errors > 0, warnings logged but do not block merge, console output shows specific violation details.
Given Lighthouse audit runs in CI, When the accessibility score is calculated, Then accessibility score >= 95, score tracked over time for regression detection, audit results saved as CI artifact.
Given Lighthouse audit runs in CI, When the PWA score is calculated, Then PWA score >= 90, all PWA criteria from Stories 6-1 and 6-2 validated, audit results saved as CI artifact.

Given the user's OS has prefers-reduced-motion: reduce enabled, When the app loads, Then app detects preference via matchMedia, animations disabled or throttled, effectiveSettings.reducedMotion = true, console log outputs [A11Y] OS prefers-reduced-motion: true, reactive to OS changes during session.

Given the user's OS has prefers-contrast: more enabled, When the app loads, Then app detects preference via matchMedia, high contrast theme tokens applied, effectiveSettings.highContrast = true, console log outputs [A11Y] OS prefers-contrast: true, reactive to OS changes during session.

Given the user's OS has prefers-color-scheme: dark enabled, When the app loads, Then app detects preference via matchMedia, dark theme applied, effectiveSettings.darkMode = true, console log outputs [A11Y] OS prefers-color-scheme: dark, reactive to OS changes during session.

Given the user wants to override OS preferences, When they toggle settings in the Settings panel, Then toggles available for Reduced Motion, High Contrast, Dark Mode, Large Text; user override stored in localStorage mp3_8d_a11y_overrides; user override takes precedence over OS preference; Reset to OS Defaults button available; overrides persist across sessions.

Given the URL includes ?debug=true query parameter, When the app loads, Then debug panel renders as floating overlay, panel draggable/minimizable, panel does not interfere with normal app usage, console log outputs [Debug] Panel enabled via query param, panel hidden when ?debug=true not present.

Given the debug panel is visible, When the user views the panel, Then four tabs available (Audio, Sensor, Session, PWA), each showing real-time data from respective providers: Audio tab shows graph nodes, isPlaying, latency, analyzer state; Sensor tab shows connected device, HR, consent list; Session tab shows active session, log count, errors, IndexedDB health; PWA tab shows SW status, cache size, audio cache count, update available flag.

Given the debug panel is open, When user clicks Copy Diagnostics button, Then JSON object generated with all debug tab data, structured error codes, timestamp and userAgent; JSON copied to clipboard; toast confirmation shown; console log outputs [Debug] Diagnostics copied.

artifact.reason: Hook pattern for service worker state management - follow for useDebugPanel PWA tab data. Returns swStatus, isOffline, updateAvailable, applyUpdate.
Hook pattern for beforeinstallprompt - similar state management pattern for useAccessibilityObserver. Shows query param parsing and localStorage patterns.
Query param parsing pattern using URLSearchParams - reuse for ?debug=true detection in useDebugPanel.
Existing CSS classes for dark-mode and high-contrast theming. Extend for accessibility observer integration.
Sensor capability detection and consent UI patterns. Debug panel Sensor tab will consume this state.
Session logging service - Debug panel Session tab will consume logCount, errors, activeSession state.
Toast notification system - use for clipboard copy confirmation in Copy Diagnostics feature.
Audio graph management - Debug panel Audio tab will show graph nodes, isPlaying, analyzer state.
Test file structure and assertion patterns. Use as template for accessibility.test.js.
Service worker mocking patterns - reference for browser API mocking in a11y tests.

constraints.constraint: All React implementation in index.html (maintaining single-file architecture)
Hook-based modular design with isolated subsystems per architecture.md Section 5
Pa11y/axe CI integration must fail build on accessibility errors greater than 0
Lighthouse Accessibility score at least 95, PWA score at least 90
Use key pattern mp3_8d_a11y_overrides for user preference storage
Console logging format: [A11Y] prefix for accessibility, [Debug] for debug panel
Maintain WCAG 2.1 AA compliance - roving tabindex, ARIA labels, focus indicators
